notes_for_editor: Thin record: four sources, all agreeing the tower is gone with no removal date. No source describes the site today, so no remains or public-access facts are set; access stays unknown. The 1938 date is 'about 1938' on firelookout.com and '1938' on Idaho Fire Lookouts; the story keeps 'about'. No new photos found; the existing idahofirelookouts.com photo in the record is unchanged. The record coordinates are the FFLA point and were not checked against a map.
